personal.title: ARCHITECT
personal.summary: Architect and computational designer with 15 years of experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex projects across various sectors. Combines design leadership with advanced expertise in BIM, computational design, and workflow automation using Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, Python, and C#. Proven track record in concept design, design development, and digital innovation that improves project quality, efficiency, and delivery outcomes.

experience.title: Principal Architect / Advanced Technology Lead
experience.responsibilities: Lead multidisciplinary design and BIM teams across international projects, define delivery strategies, and drive the adoption of advanced technology across design workflows. Oversee BIM coordination, develop computational design solutions for complex master plan and retail projects, and support optimization, automation, and quality control from concept through delivery.
notableProjects: Renovation BIM modeling for Berlin Stadtbibliothek, Germany, leading the BIM and architectural team.
Computational design and design optimization consultancy for master plan components in the Trojena mountain development in Saudi Arabia.
Computational design and design optimization for a large retail project in Dubai, UAE.

experience.title: Principal Architect / Computational Designer
experience.responsibilities: Led concept design and design development for mixed-use, master plan, and residential projects, coordinating architects, clients, and consultants throughout all project stages. Developed computational design and scripting workflows to support design optimization, automate repetitive tasks, and improve efficiency, accuracy, and overall design quality.
notableProjects: Successful competition entry for a major government master plan project in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
Concept design of a mixed-use development in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
Computational design and design optimization consultancy for master plan components in the Trojena mountain development in Saudi Arabia.
Concept design and design development of several private residential projects in Dubai, UAE.

experience.title: Architect, Senior Associate
experience.responsibilities: Led concept and computational design work for large-scale mixed-use, hospitality, and infrastructure projects across the Middle East. Managed design teams, coordinated with clients and consultants, and translated competition-winning concepts into robust design development packages.
notableProjects: Winning competition design of the Ski Village mixed-use development in Saudi Arabia (255,000 m² GFA).
Design development of the Ski Village mixed-use development in Saudi Arabia (255,000 m² GFA).
Winning design of three hotel competitions in Saudi Arabia (~20,000 m² each) and design development.
Design of the award-winning, LEED Platinum petrol station project at Dubai EXPO.

experience.title: Architect
experience.responsibilities: Contributed to concept design, computational design, and BIM development across cultural, educational, and institutional projects. Prepared client-facing presentations, supported design coordination, and developed digital models to advance projects from early design through presentation.
notableProjects: Emirates Diplomatic Academy, Abu Dhabi, UAE (18,000 m²). Government education facility.
Barjeel Gallery, Sharjah, UAE (2,000 m²). Art gallery.
Sharjah Science Museum Renovation, Sharjah, UAE (7,000 m²). Museum.
